summary: The Corruption Engine lies beneath the Discordian Crucible — a massive industrial forge where Discord energy is refined into corruption essence. The Engine’s chambers pulse with molten Discord, and Discord‑forged constructs guard the heart of the forge.
history: Constructed by Discord‑forged architects during the First Fracture.
Muramite engineers integrated corruption siphons into the forge.
War‑Shade commanders used the Engine to empower elite units.
A catastrophic overload created the Corruption Heart, a living forge entity.
The Engine now operates autonomously, refining corruption without control.
